transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me, I really appreciate your time. Um, well, I hope I'm in the right place. I guess what brings me in is... well, it's probably nothing too serious, I'm sure, but I've been having this sort of constant restless feeling? 

It's just kind of like I’m wound a little too tight, and I can’t seem to fully settle down. Even when I’m supposed to be calmly sitting through a planning meeting at work, or, you know, trying to relax by painting or doing yoga. I just always have this low-level hum where I can't quite sit still, which I know probably makes me look a bit flighty to other people. Is that... does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay, I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Do you often have trouble concentrating or staying focused?

Oh, um, no, not really. I don't think I have a problem with that. I mean, as a retail buyer, I have to look through a lot of inventory spreadsheets and vendor catalogs, and I can stay focused on the actual work just fine. 

It's more just... my body wanting to move while I'm doing it? But my mind is completely on task. I definitely don't want to give the impression that I'm falling behind at my job or anything, because I really do pay attention and get my work done. I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm answering your question correctly.
Do you worry a lot about different things most days?

Oh, um, no, I wouldn't say so. I mean, everyone has a little stress now and then, right? But I definitely don't sit around worrying about things most days. I actually try to keep a pretty positive outlook! 

I wouldn't want you to think I'm overly anxious or anything like that, because emotionally I really do feel fine. I usually just try to take things in stride. It's really just that physical restlessness I mentioned earlier. Does that help? I just want to be sure I'm giving you exactly what you need to know.
Before age 12, did you have ongoing trouble with inattention, like being easily distracted, losing things, or making careless mistakes at school?

Oh, um, inattention? No, I don't think I had trouble with that. I mean, I always tried really hard to be a good student, and I definitely wasn't losing things or anything like that. 

But, um... well, I guess since you're asking about before I was 12... I do remember in elementary school, my teachers would sometimes send notes home. It wasn't because I wasn't paying attention, though! It was more just... I had a lot of energy? I would kind of pop out of my seat a lot, or maybe accidentally talk over my classmates. And I was just so eager to participate that I'd sometimes rush to answer before the teacher even finished asking the question. 

I really wasn't trying to be disruptive or a bad kid, I promise! I just got so excited about what we were learning. I hope that doesn't make me sound like a terrible student. Does that answer your question okay?
Do you still find yourself fidgeting or feeling physically restless most days now?

Oh, um... well, I guess a little bit? But it's nothing too crazy, I promise! I mean, I sit at a desk most of the day, so I think everyone gets a little stiff, right? 

But, um, I suppose when I'm on calls with suppliers... my foot is usually bouncing under the desk. And I might be, you know, clicking a pen or twisting my ring around. Actually, I sometimes have to make sure I mute myself or keep my hands off camera so it doesn't distract anyone. 

I really try to keep it under control, though! I don't want my vendors to think I'm not taking our meetings seriously, because I absolutely am. It's just a little way to channel that extra energy while I'm sitting still. Is that the kind of thing you meant? I hope I'm explaining it right.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot most days?

Oh, um, I think you might have asked me that a little earlier? But no, I really don't. I mean, I try to be a pretty upbeat person! I definitely wouldn't say I sit around worrying or feeling anxious most days. I really do feel emotionally fine, I promise. I just try to take things as they come, you know? I hope that's okay, I'm just trying to make sure I'm giving you consistent answers!
Do these restlessness and impulsive habits cause problems in more than one part of your life, like at work and at home?

Oh, um... well, I guess maybe a little bit? But I really try not to let it cause any major problems, I promise! I mean, I want to be good at my job and be a good mom and everything. 

But... I suppose at work, um, sometimes I might rush a little too much? Like, I've had to correct a few purchase orders after the fact. And my planning coordinator has started double-checking my stuff a bit more. Which is totally fine! She's just being thorough, and I really appreciate her help. I definitely don't want to make it sound like I'm messing up all the time, because I'm really not. 

And, um, at home... well, I guess family dinners can get just a tiny bit tense sometimes. I just get so excited to jump into the conversation, and I think sometimes my family feels like I'm talking over them. I feel terrible about it! I really don't mean to be rude, I just have so much I want to say. I'm really working on being a better listener, though. Does that make sense? I hope I'm not making myself sound like a total disaster!
